name: HiBid Sniper
install: cd hibid-sniper && npm ci && npm run build

terminals.name: dashboard
terminals.command: cd hibid-sniper && DEMO_MODE=true PORT=8080 npm start
terminals.description: HiBid Sniper dashboard + bidding engine on port 8080. DEMO_MODE=true runs against a simulated auction, so no browser or hibid.com access is needed. For real bidding, unset DEMO_MODE and provide the HiBid secrets described in hibid-sniper/README.md.
